	rejectHandler := func(ctx context.Context, u app.Identity, key string, ids []string) (protocol.Result, bool, error) {
		rejected, replayed, err := executor.Run(ctx, u, reject, key, ids)
		var denied *action.Rejection
		if errors.As(err, &denied) {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, &protocol.Rejection{Status: denied.Status}
		}
		if err != nil {
			return protocol.Result{}, false, err
		}
		return protocol.Result{Field: reject.Field, IDs: rejected}, replayed, nil
	}
	return protocol.HTTP(protocol.Routes{
		"/purchases/bulk-approve": approve,
		"/purchases/bulk-reject":  rejectHandler,
	}, fallback), nil
}
